pages.title: What It Gives
pages.text:
Throughput. Anything you can make, you can make thousands of. It is the only power that works while you are asleep.

It denies you your body. A Forge player who meets something in the dark is a civilian.

pages.title: Your First Hour
pages.text:
1. Smelt and combine until you have ANDESITE ALLOY. Everything starts there.
2. Build a WATER WHEEL on flowing water. That is your first power.
3. Make a MILLSTONE and a MECHANICAL PRESS.
4. Press iron into SHEETS. Sheets are the gate to almost everything else.

pages.title: Then
pages.text:
Shafts and cogs carry rotation. Speed and stress are the only two numbers that matter - a machine stops because you ran out of one of them. A gearbox turns a corner. A windmill beats a water wheel if you build it big enough.

The ceiling here is steam and early electricity. No oil, no diesel. Aim at a STEAM ENGINE and you have arrived.
